paper.abstract_en: It has recently been claimed that algebraic methods can be used to give a background-independent description of semiclassical gravity. This paper aims to provide an entry point into recent algebraic approaches to quantum gravity and to analyse and critically assess the conception of background-independence here involved. We discuss an algebraic framework for formulating an algebra of observables along the worldline of an observer in a cosmological setting. By 'gravitationally dressing' the observables to the observer's worldline, the reference to the spacetime background can be set aside at the level of the abstract *-algebra. Thus this *-algebra is taken to be independent of any particular spacetime realisation, with different states on the algebra corresponding to different backgrounds. We compare this algebraic framework to three influential notions of background-independence in the literature and argue that none of these fully captures the sense in which the *-algebra is taken to be background-independent. Building on this, we extract a novel notion of algebraic background-independence tied to the representation-independence of the *-algebra. This algebraic conception motivates two further concepts of background-independence tailored to semiclassical theories: semiclassical background-independence and perturbative background-independence. We suggest that these provide useful tools for evaluating the scope and limitations of semiclassical approaches to quantum gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文聚焦半经典引力的代数背景无关性，涉及量子引力基础概念分析，与引力学基础主题高度相关，理论深度较高，并提出了新的概念区分，值得研究者进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 近来有人主张，代数方法可用于给出半经典引力的背景无关描述。本文旨在为近期量子引力的代数进路提供一个入门指引，并分析、批判性地评估其中所涉及的背景无关性概念。我们讨论一个代数框架，用于在宇宙学情形下沿观察者世界线构造可观测量代数。通过把可观测量"引力地修饰"到观察者的世界线上，对时空背景的指涉可以在抽象*-代数层面被搁置。因此，该*-代数被视为独立于任何特定的时空实现，而代数上的不同态对应于不同的背景。我们将这一代数框架与文献中三种有影响力的背景无关性概念进行比较，并论证其中任何一种都未能完全刻画该*-代数被视为背景无关的那种意义。在此基础上，我们提取出一种与*-代数表示无关性相关联的新的代数背景无关性概念。这一代数式构想又激发出两个为半经典理论量身定制的进一步概念：半经典背景无关性与微扰背景无关性。我们认为，这些概念为评估半经典量子引力进路的适用范围与局限提供了有用的工具。
